overview_description.description:
Diverse candidates are often systematically excluded when it comes to campus recruiting and high-volume hiring. 

Headstart diversity recruiting software breaks this cycle of exclusion and levels the playing field for all candidates by removing bias from recruiting processes. 

When it comes to diversity, we are all in.
